title: the_cowboy_and_the_lady_and_her_pa_b_a_story_of_a__cobb
author: Cobb, Irvin S. (Irvin Shrewsbury)
summary: When his socialite daughter falls for a dashing cowboy guide on a Western vacation, the shrewd Mr. Gatling cures her infatuation not by opposing the match but by secretly outfitting the rugged young man in ludicrous "Eastern" clothes, making him unappealing—then offers the good-hearted youth a ranch job instead.
